project_type: React + TypeScript + Vite SPA with Supabase backend and Express API server
build_system: Vite 8.3.0 with @tailwindcss/vite plugin (Tailwind CSS v4), npm workspaces, concurrently for dev
test_framework: None currently configured - no test runner, use TypeScript compilation and build verification
test_command: npm run lint (runs tsc --noEmit for type checking only)
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run lint' to verify TypeScript compilation with no errors. 2. Run 'npm run build' to ensure production build succeeds. 3. Test manually in browser at localhost:5173 after 'npm run dev'.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ folder is generated by build but gitignored. No snapshot files to update.
environment_constraints: Project uses 'npm run dev:all' to start both frontend (Vite on :5173) and backend (Express on :3001). Never restart servers - HMR handles frontend changes. API proxy configured in vite.config.ts for /api routes.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md or CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow existing patterns: services in src/services/, components in src/components/, Supabase types in src/lib/supabase.ts. All external links must use target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer' per existing linkGeneratorService.ts pattern. Use existing Auth context via useAuth() hook.
key_patterns: 1. Service layer pattern: create *Service.ts files for API/external integrations (realWeatherService.ts, bucketListService.ts as examples). 2. Component structure: Lucide React icons, Tailwind classes with project design tokens from index.css. 3. Supabase: Always check user auth via useAuth(), use supabase client from lib/supabase.ts, type interfaces in SavedTrip format. 4. Tailwind v4: No tailwind.config file - styles via @import 'tailwindcss' in index.css with CSS variables (--color-accent, --color-bg-primary, etc.). Dark mode must use CSS classes and context. 5. Modal pattern: All modals follow isOpen/onClose prop pattern (AuthModal.tsx, SavedTripsModal.tsx, BucketListModal.tsx as examples).
directory_structure: src/components/ (all React components), src/services/ (API/external service integrations), src/contexts/ (React contexts), src/lib/ (Supabase client), src/utils/ (business logic helpers), src/data/ (static data like destinations), src/types/ (TypeScript interfaces). Root has package.json, vite.config.ts, tsconfig.json.
